chunks: Then We facilitated (your birth). How well do We calculate!
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'Fana'ma al-Qadirun' mean in the context of Surah Al-Mursalat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Allah's attribute of *al-Qadir* (The All-Powerful) and His precise, purposeful decree (*al-Qadar*) in the cosmic order. It serves as a reminder that divine planning is not merely mechanical but an act of supreme wisdom, often linked to the selection and guidance of the Prophets and Imams. The phrase 'Ni'ma al-Qadirun' (Excellent are the Calculators) highlights the perfection of His ability to measure and ordain all things with exactitude.
